protocol.diagnosis: Eight HC64 known old-baseline-wrong and candidate-rescuable cases inspected before design; recheck cases not newly inspected. All cohorts historically exposed.
protocol.candidate_pool: Same old12 view MBR plus incumbent; no new oracle boundary proposals.
protocol.representation: Continuous1.5x full-timeline complete-box ROI on actual cached text-conditioned motion memory; normalized ROI minus normalized global motion; fixed per-query intercept/time/time-squared detrending. Same construction for area-preserving spatial permutation. Last native hidden similarly normalized and detrended.
protocol.whole_interval: Physical-cell-weighted prefix/event/suffix mean-state explained energy; H from native hidden, S from target motion gain minus global-motion gain.
protocol.decision: Strict improvement over incumbent in BOTH H and S; maximize weaker ordinal-rank improvement, native utility tie-break only. No mixing weight, no confidence threshold. Hidden/spatial-only, permuted/global matched structural controls.
protocol.matched: PriorMatched and fixed-seed RandomMatched change on exactly the label-free StateJoint intervention queries. Same candidate budget; no GT gating.
protocol.budget: One structural revision, no weight/temperature search. Single CPU thread/nice15; no RGB, model/decoder/head/expert/GPU/update.
protocol.adoption: HC64 must have positive t/fullv/fixedv and outperform StateHidden/StatePermuted in t, Source-relative severe v harm <=baseline+2; then both frozen32 groups positive t and nonnegative fullv, pooled equal-domain t lower95>0 and v lower95>-.5pp. No recheck-driven redesign.
